status: user-authorized team protocol; not supplied official numeric conventions
selection: both hands finite and unflagged at every scored timestamp
origin: last existing hand timestamp at or before nominal grid origin
prefix: all existing numeric observations through origin; independent window replay
return: latest existing samples at request time, disclosed only after response delay
waiting: union of in-flight intervals clipped to the experimental window
event_order: deliver due responses, choose action, deliver zero-delay response, score prediction
weighting: equal environments; equal episodes within environment; equal windows within episode; equal scored times and hands within window
test_status: Q1 test records previously observed; do not evaluate Q2 until complete pipeline is frozen
